module: Shared imgui display functions for the Vehicle Editor's powertrain inspector (vePowerTrain). They show the jbeam data of a device (recursive tree) and its live data (angular velocities, torques, ratios, clutch...), with fields specific to the device type (combustionEngine, differential, shaft, manualGearbox, frictionClutch, torqueConverter, automaticGearbox, cvtGearbox, dctGearbox).
notes: The `device` values come from powertrain.serializeDevicesInfo() on the vehicle side, copied into vEditor.powertrainDevices.
showJbeamData reads vEditor.vdata.powertrain[deviceID]; deviceID is the 0-based Lua index used by vePowerTrain.
For manualGearbox, the loop `for i=0,#device.gearDamages` uses the # operator on a table that may start at 0.

displayLivedataByType.desc: Displays in two columns the live fields specific to the device type (for example engineLoad for an engine, diffAngle/outputAV2/outputTorque2 for a differential, clutchAngle/lockSpring for a clutch).

device.desc: Serialized live data of the device.

displayLivedata.desc: Displays the common live data: inputAV, outputAV1/2, outputTorque1/2, isBroken, mode, virtualMassAV, isPhysicallyDisconnected, gearRatio, cumulativeGearRatio, cumulativeInertia.

device.desc: Serialized live data of the device.

showJbeamData.desc: Displays in a tree node 'All jbeam data' all the jbeam data of the device vEditor.vdata.powertrain[deviceID].

deviceID.desc: Index of the device in vdata.powertrain (0-based).

initialize.desc: Assigns the global `vEditor` to the given instance.
